entities.summary: Benjamin José Molina, nicknamed "Big Money", is a Puerto Rican sports commentator and former professional baseball catcher who is the Spanish radio color analyst for the St. Louis Cardinals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played 13 seasons in MLB for the Anaheim Angels / Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, Toronto Blue Jays, San Francisco Giants, and Texas Rangers. He is the older brother of major league catchers José Molina and Yadier Molina.
